dogecoin.text: Hype and making money first got me involved in #Bitcoin in 2017. Now I’m all about #Zilliqa. Once we get the mass adoption, people will get really into the tech. Maybe your gateway was $BTC, $ETH, $ADA, $DOGE etc. Then you learn and you find the best. #Zilliqa will be king soon

I think Elon just wants to drive down the price of #Bitcoin so he can buy it cheaper. #Dogecoin can prosper as well but there is only one digital gold and that’s #BTC. Max supply has to matter. #cryptocurrency #cryptoassets
